 Feds raid billionaire’s Beverly Hills mansion in dramatic Eric Swalwell probe — as source reveals sex worker link 
 By 
 Titus Wu and 
 Josh Christenson 
 Published 
 Oct. 27, 2026 
 Updated 
 Oct. 27, 2026, 10:41 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make California Post a Preferred Source 
 The FBI on Tuesday morning raided a Beverly Hills mansion as part of the investigation into disgraced California politician Eric Swalwell. A senior law enforcement official told The Post the raid was connected to a sex worker.
 The raid is believed to have targeted the home of billionaire Stephen Cloobeck, who prominently backed Swalwell’s run for governor and even let him stay at his mansion in Southern California.
 8 
 A house belonging to Stephen Cloobeck is raided on Oct. 27, 2026, in Beverly Hills, Calif. Obtained by the CA Post 
 8 
 A house belonging to Stephen Cloobeck is raided at 1014 N. Roxbury Drive in Beverly Hills, Calif., Los Angeles County, on Oct. 27, 2026. Obtained by the CA Post 
 However, when allegations surfaced that former Congressman Swalwell sexually assaulted mutlple women including former staffers, Cloobeck changed his mind and reportedly evicted him out of the house.
 “I am no longer associated with a man that takes advantage of women,” Cloobeck said. “I support women’s rights.”

 8 
 Feds raided billionaire Stephen Cloobeck’s Beverly Hills mansion Tuesday morning as the investigation into Eric Swalwell took another turn. Fox News 
 Swalwell is under investigation by multiple prosecutors for the sexual assault allegations, including in New York and California.
 Back in August, Swalwell was surrounded by FBI agents at San Francisco International Airport as he deboarded a plane, leading to the seizure of his cellphone and laptop as part of a federal criminal investigation.
 BREAKING: FBI raids Beverly Hills mansion as part of Eric Swalwell investigation pic.twitter.com/ae3ivT6Fp8 
— Fox News (@FoxNews) October 27, 2026 
 Agents executed additional warrants the following day at Swalwell’s Washington, D.C., home, where they seized other potential evidence, a source previously told The Post.
 The FBI warrant used to seize Swalwell’s phone and laptop cited a federal civil-rights statute that can be used to prosecute public officials who abuse their government power — suggesting the feds may suspect Swalwell used his official role to silence women who accused him of sexual misconduct.
 8 
 Stephen Cloobeck’s house is raided in Beverly Hills, Calif., Los Angeles County, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026. Obtained by the CA Post 
 8 
 One former staffer has accused Swalwell of raping her when she was too intoxicated to consent, according to the San Francisco Chronicle. Another woman has accused him of drugging and sexually assaulting her in 2018, while two others have alleged he sent them unsolicited images of his genitals.
 8 
 Stephen Cloobeck speaks to Fox News out side his mansion in April 2026. David Buchan for California Post 
 Swalwell has denied wrongdoing, but he dropped out of the governor’s race and resigned from Congress soon after the allegations surfaced.
 Cloobeck was one of Swalwell’s largest benefactors, spending over $1 million to support Swalwell’s California gubernatorial campaign, giving the maximum $39,200 direct contribution, and providing a private $31,000 trip to France in 2024.
 8 
 Eric Swalwell, D-Calif., speaks on the second day of former President Donald Trump’s second impeachment trial at the U.S. Capitol in Washington, Wednesday, Feb. 10, 2021 Getty Images 
 Swalwell frequently lived and stayed out of Cloobeck’s Beverly Hills mansion, even filming a video response to misconduct allegations from inside the home.
 8 
 Stephen Cloobeck speaks to Fox News outside his mansion in California, Monday, April 13, 2026. Cloobeck cut ties with Eric Swalwell and revealed he kicked him out of his mansion hours before the congressman dropped his run for California governor. David Buchan for California Post 
 Cloobeck himself ran for governor before dropping out to make way for Swalwell.
 The benefactor, while he now disavows Swalwell, has had troubles of his own. He was about to marry a Penthouse Pet accused of stealing from rich sugar daddies before calling it off.
 Cloobeck was charged with three felony counts of attempting to dissuade or prevent a witness or victim from testifying, and one misdemeanor count of making annoying phone calls.  All charges stem from his ex-partner Adva Lavie’s criminal case in which she’s accused of using dating apps to steal from rich older men.
